text: Lab forms decide what staff fill in for each in-house test. Attached to a test, the form opens by itself when the test is charged.
Remember: attach every form to the labs or procedures that use it.
This is Settings, In-House Lab Forms. Active forms are in use. Archived ones are kept, out of the way.
Table of values is for rows of results. Written summary is for write-ups, like cytology.
Choices, for answers like Negative or Positive.

To retire a form, Archive it. Results already charted stay readable.
Open one, and Restore brings it back.
Number rows have units, and no ranges. Scout doesn't judge numbers.
